title: SAP Shutdown / Maintenance Calendar
description: Planned shutdown and maintenance windows from SAP Plant Maintenance (PM). One row per shutdown event. Used to flag shutdown-driven demand and exclude/attribute consumption during shutdowns.

shutdown_id.description: Unique identifier for the shutdown event.

plant.description: Plant code the shutdown applies to, e.g. VED-ZAM-001.

shutdown_type.description: Classification, e.g. PLANNED, UNPLANNED, TURNAROUND, STATUTORY.

affected_equipment.description: Equipment / functional location affected (PM EQUNR or TPLNR).

maintenance_order.description: AUFNR. PM maintenance order number linked to the shutdown.
